# Southern South America interior batch 3

Research snapshot: 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles). Parent work item: [#444](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/444). This is a source and identity review of only the 230 IDs in the frozen v5 scope. It does not certify Argentina South, Chile Central, the macro-region, any complete region, or import readiness.

## Scope and result

The scope has 53 Argentina ADM2 department records and 177 Chile ADM3 commune records. It owns those 53 of 54 Argentina South members and 177 of 252 Chile Central members. The remaining Argentina South country-SPI member is covered by [#928](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/928); the other 75 Chile Central members are within the disjoint, active [#445](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/445). The botanical-region basis is WGSRPD Level 3, whose botanical units are not guaranteed to follow purely political factors; therefore the areas' territorial meaning remains unresolved. The fixed macro envelope was held constant.

`location-assessments.jsonl` gives one explicit disposition and a factual limit for every scoped ID (one JSON record per line). Counts are 116 `justified`, 113 `correction-needed`, and 1 `insufficient-evidence`. Here `justified` is deliberately narrow: the current name/administrative role, parent association, and coarse comparison support retaining the identity for now. It does **not** mean its legal boundary is correct, its source complete, its source license clear, or its region/area placement approved. Parent dispositions are included as `record_type=parent` rows in the same JSON Lines ledger; it covers all 29 scoped parent nodes, including all six Argentina parents and 23 Chile province parents.

## Fixed inputs and restoration

The work item pins v5 hierarchy `03d23534f87cdd0582bcb228780f00f65090bec2e8a760acbab528383f28549d`, footprints `2ac42eeb9fef8af923a0d4c4e55af49ca0a103de891ffbfb2c1181ad75950286`, macro certificate `979afaf22e10dc936ecfe80a8cd288b2ef33d8c7bf509aba9fae4255e3d94d6e`, frozen region geometry `b6d1cc0a41110da332ecca2a4f08519f1d97e7810757d84189cd44642e048798`, and frozen member roster `4447e260a67aeb468ab19584e45868fc3470dc4c0e989bdac21aa99589502e9c`. The exact issue snapshot and release envelope are retained in `issue-scope-pinned.json` and `scope.json`.

The referenced geoBoundaries source is the immutable GitHub commit `9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d`; original ARG ADM2 source SHA-256 is `cedee8710e49d9017327fc1d4b2dc536e95a82317dc94c3bac8d9404af6bf771` (69,702,323 bytes), and CHL ADM3 is `f6852723bc6d44d4813086fe9df750e7228e1925a72284e3d2b65ed44e2aa99a` (171,783,952 bytes). Both cite CC BY 3.0 IGO in the existing source metadata. They exceed the 32 MiB evidence-file bound. Restore the exact bytes from:

- `https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/raw/9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d/releaseData/gbOpen/ARG/ADM2/geoBoundaries-ARG-ADM2.geojson`
- `https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/raw/9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d/releaseData/gbOpen/CHL/ADM3/geoBoundaries-CHL-ADM3.geojson`

Verify the whole-file hashes above before using them. Do not substitute the current geoBoundaries release.

## Tier, parent, and completeness interpretation

For this packet, Argentina ADM2 rows are provincial departments; the official IGN layer's `NAM`, department code, province code, and department type fields support the source role and the department-to-province association. Chile ADM3 rows are communes; Subdere's 2023 DPA explicitly provides commune polygons and province/region codes, so the inspected source supports the commune-to-province tier for present-day administrative reference. Chile's Law 16,441 article 1 defines one Isla de Pascua commune-subdelegation and places Easter Island and Salas y Gómez in the same department. Decree 324 (1991) explicitly identifies the island as part of the Isla de Pascua commune and province, fixes its location at 26°28′17″S 105°21′55″W, and directs official use of the name **Isla Salas y Gómez**. These legal texts establish administrative meaning, not shoreline vertices. The current BCN 2024 commune report identifies the Isla de Pascua commune under Valparaíso Region and Isla de Pascua Province.

The retained geoBoundaries feature is `Isla de Pascua`, 2020 `ADM3` / `Communes`, shapeID `31580391B33082267781919`.
